decisions.statement: The retype is left to the mechanical change stating a page as another page type.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
The page and the page type it becomes are the two arguments read here.
The page type a page moves to is named by the path of that page type's page.
A name a property fixes is chosen outside akasha and carries no page type.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one page stated as another page type, in the data and in every file name
